title: Special Order for VIP Transportation, Inc., ex parte. — VIP Transportation, Inc., ex parte. In re: Request for cancellation of LPSC No. 7212. THEREFORE, IT IS ORDERED LPSC No. 7212 hereby is, cancelled.

documents.text:
LOUISIANA PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION

                           SPECIAL ORDER NUMBER 64-2026

                               VIP TRANSPORTATION, INC.
                                       EX PARTE

                       In re: Request for cancellation of LPSC No. 7212
On information and belief that the carrier wishes to close LPSC No. 7212 per a notarized affidavit
received on October 1, 2026, it is therefore ORDERED that LPSC No. 7212 held by VIP
Transportation, Inc. is hereby CANCELLED and REVOKED, with all outstanding fees and fines
owed the Commission to be paid by the carrier in the event of any reinstatement.

                                   (Decided October 1, 2026)




BY ORDER OF THE COMMISSION
BATON ROUGE, LOUISIANA
October 2, 2026



                                                 DISTRICT I
                                                 CHAIRMAN ERIC F. SKRMETTA
